author: neal_illustrator
title: Looking for artists for comic and animation teams
content: Heyo! I’m doing an all call looking for artists to help build out my comic and animation teams! I think it’s time to try and ease up some of the stress and expand my team! I’m excited to see y’all’s portfolios! Application Links are in my linktree (in bio)

author: harrier_studio
title: Harrier Studio is hiring illustrators and comic artists
content: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING! OPEN POSITIONS: Illustrator (Full Stage), Sketch Artist (Drafter), Line Artist, Colorist, Compositor, Storyboard Artist, Styling Artist, Typesetter. Send CV & Portfolio to: harrierstdrecruitment@gmail.com (Subject: Name – Position – CV & Portfolio). Open until all positions filled.

author: kisai_ent
title: Kisai Entertainment hiring sketch and finishing artists
content: Kisai sedang mencari: Business Development Officer (KY Academy), Business Development Officer (Original IP), Sketch Artist (Western Style), Sketch Artist (Action or Romance), Finishing Artist. author: willai3213
title: Seeking graphic designer for exhibition including character visuals
content: Preparing an exhibition at Huashan, Taipei in early December. Looking for a graphic designer for main visual, wordmark, character visuals (6 designs, not too complex), character standees, window stickers, banners, and other exhibition materials. Timeline Oct–Dec 2026. Prefer exhibition/graphic design experience, hand-drawn Japanese warm style. Interested designers comment or DM with portfolio + quote.

author: truchargv
title: Looking for artists to join illustrator pool
content: We're looking for some incredible artists to join our Illustrator pool! Tap the link in bio to apply! Our illustrator pool is used for articles, newsletters, social media posts etc. Illustrators will be chosen and reached out to as needed.
